title: ui i18n: split the 11 large locale files by feature namespace with a script, move-only (hot-file card D)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. On 2026-11-15 the maintainer chose 「今天改规则,并立全部 6 张卡」 on the hot-file serialization decision card (consequence as shown: 取消 protocol.ts 独占、关闭 #25467 和 #24586;卡 A 到 F 交各车道立卡,大 PR 和上限门禁仍逐个等您批准). Measurements: the hot-file analysis report (project artifact), re-runnable on request. Cross-lane rule (2026-11-15): no live seat in the owning lane, so `domain:server` seat 5 files and builds it; the owning lane is notified.

## Card D (owning lane: ui)

Split the 11 large `ui/packages/i18n` locale files by feature namespace, with a script, so new copy adds files instead of editing the shared large ones.

- Move-only: no key or value changes; the script proves key-set and value identity per locale before/after.
- Update loaders and the i18n gates (en drift, key census, zh-Hant generation) to the new layout in the same PR.
- ⛔ A PR over 3,000 lines needs the maintainer's approval before it opens (the ruling keeps large PRs one by one): measure the diff size first and ask through the seat.
